_comment: Storage backend selection. 'sqlite' (default) = single-file local storage. 'mysql' (or 'mariadb') = shared database for multi-server networks with unified balances (Solidus 2.2.0+). The mysql.password value may be overridden with the SOLIDUS_DB_PASSWORD environment variable (recommended).

mysql._ssl_comment: SECURITY (2.2.5): useSsl defaults to TRUE - encryption is the safe default for the multi-server mode this backend exists for. Only set it to false when the database truly runs on the same machine (host 127.0.0.1/localhost); a cleartext connection to any other host is loudly warned in the log. With useSsl=true the server certificate must verify against the JVM trust store, or point 'serverSslCert' (JDBC URL parameter, see docs/sql/mysql/) at your self-signed certificate.

redis._redis_comment: OPTIONAL coordination layer (2.2.1): L2 balance cache + pub/sub invalidation + instant network-wide notifications. Never the source of truth - the shared database stays authoritative, and a Redis outage degrades to plain database reads. The redis password may be overridden with the SOLIDUS_REDIS_PASSWORD environment variable (passwordEnv names that variable). SECURITY (2.2.5): only redis:// and rediss:// schemes are accepted; use rediss:// for TLS-encrypted connections (certificate verified against the JVM trust store) when Redis is reached over a network, and prefer passwordEnv over embedding credentials in the uri (any credentials in the uri are redacted from logs).

integrity._integrity_comment: Supply-integrity scheduler (2.2.4): periodically re-audits that SUM(all balances) equals the ledger-replayed expectation (shop faucets/sinks + admin ops + new-row starting mints) and that the escrow account equals the open top bids. Warnings are read-only and never touch money. On a multi-server network set 'elected': true on EXACTLY ONE server (default true is correct for single-server installs; a duplicate election only duplicates warnings).
